subject: FP3 Q8 replaced with W2.e, pushed
body:

New Q8: g(x) = -3|x+4|-2 transformation identification (W2.e). Four inputs: horizontal shift (-4), vertical shift (-2), reflected over x-axis (yes), stretch factor (3). Committed at fe7d53e and pushed to origin. GitHub Pages will deploy within a few minutes.

W3.e left out per your recommendation. Agreed on minimum disruption while Kai is running.
